node.title: Rate-half FPC5 M=4,t=2 guarded split-locator payment
node.statement: For the official rate-half row, fix one admissible maximal M=4 sunflower source. Aggregate every non-planted FPC5 contributor touching exactly two full petals by one internal tangent, quotient/profile, or polynomial first owner. General first-layout domination proves that this one-layout payment plus at most four anchors is already global over source layouts. At the sharp endpoint, the guarded locator image is now proved to be a typed projective split-flat with root-domain size 5ell-5, locator degree 2ell-3, projective dimension ell-2, affine codimension ell-1, unique numerator reconstruction, exact PMA filters, and honest common-GCD normalization. The remaining content is its growing-dimensional split count plus the nonsharp cells, with internal-owner multiplicity preserved.
node.attack_surface: prove the growing-dimensional guarded split-flat count in one fixed rate-half source, exploiting the cofactor congruence and exact PMA filters after honest common-GCD normalization
node.falsifier: a fixed official rate-half source whose internally first-owned two-full-petal contributors exceed every polynomial and legitimate profile column
